_comment: Recette R-535 (2026-10-01): package references the launcher's outdated-NuGet guard does not count, each with its reason and its end condition. An exception is never permanent: once the solution targets untilTargetFramework or later, the guard reports it as expired and counts the package again, so the pin is revisited instead of forgotten.

exceptions.reason: EF Core stays on 10.x on the net11.0 target (ADR-048): the Npgsql EF Core provider 11 is only 11.0.0-rc.3 and no prerelease ships. Ends when Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 11 is stable, then EF, the dotnet-ef tool and this exception move to 11.
Same pin as Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design: its 11.0.0 depends on EF Core 11.
